rulesNotes: Positive technology-course scenario: INFT 110 retains 3 credits; the source also permits passing an assessment. No assessment waiver is assumed.

THEO 201 and THEO 202 may also be waived for at least 60 undergraduate transfer credits; individual university evaluation is required.
